[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。

texts.zh:
[Root.Federation.GetName]代表星系舞台上一股强大的力量，但是其舰队分散在各处，并且在不同的组织结构下运作。近日，联邦各地几位颇具影响力的军事专家对我们能否面对协调统一、实力强大的敌人表示担忧。

为弥补实力上的不足，他们制定了一套方案，计划在联邦范围内进行一系列军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。根据他们的计划，每支舰队将派出特遣队前往盟友领土的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。成功完成演习是我军的重要使命，将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。
texts.en:
The [Root.Federation.GetName] represents a powerful force on the galactic stage; however, its fleets are divided and operate under a disparate set of organizational structures. Recently, several influential military experts from across the federation have raised concerns about our ability to face a well-coordinated and powerful enemy.

To rectify this, they have drawn up plans for a federation-wide series of military exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews. Under their plans, detachments from each of our fleets would move to specific locations in our allies' territories and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously. Successfully holding these exercises would be a significant commitment for our armed forces but would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness.

label.zh: 我们的舰队已准备好应对一切可能发生的情况。
label.en: Our fleet is already ready for all eventualities.

texts.zh:
尊贵的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]，你们好！我们齐心协力，打造了一股强大的力量，即使在星系舞台上也不容小觑。但是，我们担心，如果出现实力强大、协调统一的威胁，我们目前的实力可能不足以与之抗衡。我们的专家制定了一套方案，计划进行一系列联邦联合军事演习，以便建立军队凝聚力，磨练船员的技能：我们打算让每支舰队派出特遣队前往联邦领土内的特定地点，进行一系列复杂的演习，与其他参加的舰队相互协调，确保行动同步进行。

我们相信，这些演习将大大提高我们联邦的战备水平。你们愿意参与演习吗？
texts.en:
Greetings, noble [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralCompliment]! Together, we have built a powerful force worthy of notice on the galactic stage. However, we are concerned that this may not be enough should a powerful and well-coordinated threat arise. Our experts have drawn up plans for a series of joint federation exercises to build cohesion within our militaries and hone the skills of our crews: we intend that detachments from each of our fleets move to specific locations in federation territory and perform a series of complex maneuvers, coordinating with other participating fleets to ensure that the operations are executed simultaneously.

We are confident that these exercises would appreciably boost our federation's military readiness. Will you join this venture?

label.zh: 我们没有可供你演习调用的舰队！
label.en: We cannot spare any of our fleets for your games!

texts.zh: 我们的大使已竭尽全力说服[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国参与我们的联合军事演习计划。但遗憾的是，我们的盟友普遍不感兴趣，比起提高联合作战能力，他们更愿意相信自己的力量。
texts.en: Our ambassadors have sought to persuade the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] to participate in our plans for joint military exercises. Unfortunately, however, they have been met with widespread disinterest, our allies preferring to trust in their own strength rather than seeking to improve our joint capacities.

texts.zh: 尽管我们支持举行联邦联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议，但由于其他成员国并未对此提供足够的支持，计划似乎已经宣告失败。
texts.en: Despite our backing for the [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint federation military exercises, it seems that the plan has fallen through. There was simply not enough support for it among the other member states.

texts.zh: 我们反对在[Root.Federation.GetName]举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]计划，并且反对声音已初见成效。大部分成员国都认为没必要把军队的注意力放在这种琐事上。
texts.en: Our opposition to [From.GetAdj] plans for joint military exercises in the [Root.Federation.GetName] has borne fruit. A majority of members saw no need to waste our military's attention on such trivialities.

texts.zh: 我们提出的在[Root.Federation.GetName]成员国之间举行联合军事演习的计划得到了大多数盟友的支持。所有参加的成员国将立即着手准备！
texts.en: Our plans for joint military exercises among the members of the [Root.Federation.GetName] have been met with approval among a majority of our allies. All participating members will begin preparations immediately!

label.zh: 集结舰队，让敌人颤抖吧！
label.en: Together our fleets shall strike fear into our enemies!

texts.zh: 在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。我们得尽快着手准备！
texts.en: The [From.GetAdj] initiative to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. We shall begin our preparations for them immediately!

texts.zh: 尽管我们反对，但在联邦成员国舰队之间举行联合军事演习的[From.GetAdj]提议得到了大部分成员国的支持。幸运的是，[From.GetName]没有办法强制要求我们参加这个计划。
texts.en: Despite our opposition, [From.GetAdj] plans to hold joint military exercises between federation member states' fleets has met with approval among the majority of members. Fortunately, there is nothing the [From.GetName] can do to force us to participate in the scheme.

label.zh: 集结舰队，让敌人颤抖吧！
label.en: Together our fleets shall strike fear into our enemies!

label.zh: 这是对时间和精力的浪费，真遗憾。
label.en: An unfortunate waste of time and energy.

title.zh: 联合演习的准备工作完成

texts.zh: 我们已为联邦联合军事演习做好万全准备，只需等待盟友的舰队就位，就可以开始行动！
texts.en: We are all set for the joint federation military exercises. We need merely wait for our allies' fleets to move into place before the operations begin!

texts.zh: 所有联邦舰队现已就位，训练演习可立即开始！一组高机动性的轻装目标从先前隐藏的位置现身，在为期30天的演习中，这些目标会尽力避免被我们的舰船摧毁。
texts.en: All federation fleets are now in place, so the training exercises may commence! A set of lightly-armed but highly mobile targets have emerged from a previously hidden location and are seeking to avoid destruction by our ships before the 30 days time limit expires.

label.zh: 武器已锁定目标并装填完毕！

texts.zh: 我们已成功消灭联合军事演习中的目标。只能希望我们的盟友也同样勤奋！
texts.en: We have successfully eliminated our target in the joint military exercises. We can but hope that our allies have been equally diligent!

texts.zh: 我们未能消灭联合军事演习中的目标，舰队军官因此羞愧难当。我们只能希望盟友能够更加成功！
texts.en: To the immeasurable shame of our naval officers, we have failed to eliminate our target in the joint military exercises. We can only hope that our allies have been more successful!

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习称得上是鼓舞人心的巨大成功，每支参与演习的队伍都不费吹灰之力地摧毁了目标，彻底证明了我们联邦舰队超凡的技能和卓越的协调能力！在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
texts.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have immediately been declared a rousing success, each participating fleet having struck down their targets without untoward difficulty, proving once and for all the excellent skill and superior coordination of our federation fleet! Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习现已结束。这次演习相对来说差强人意：尽管并非所有舰队都能消灭其目标，但大部分参加的舰队都取得了成功，这说明联邦舰队有能力协调执行复杂的任务。此外，我们的船员也从这次经历中受益颇多，目前像往常一样准备充分，随时可以执行任务。在向我们开战前，敌人一定会再三考虑。
texts.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have now concluded. They have been declared a partial success: although not every party was able to eliminate their target, most participating fleets were able to do so, demonstrating that the federation's fleet is capable of coordinating to perform sophisticated tasks. Additionally, our crews have benefited greatly from the experience and are now as ready for action as ever before. Our enemies will surely think twice before they pick a fight with us now.

texts.zh: [Root.Federation.GetName]的军事演习现已结束，但过程有一点讽刺：尽管部分参加的舰队能够击中目标，但大多数舰队都未能成功，这让我们不禁怀疑，[Root.Federation.GetName]是否有能力组织统一的军事行动。我们只能希望敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展……
texts.en: The [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in a slightly farcical manner: although some participants were able to strike their targets, a majority failed to do so, casting doubt on the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s ability to work as a unified force in military matters.  We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely...

texts.zh: 居然没有一个参加演习的成员国能在时限内消灭目标，[Root.Federation.GetName]的联合军事演习也随之以闹剧告终。我们只能希望，在我们尽力捡起失去的骄傲、恢复舰队的尊严时，敌人没有过于密切地关注演习的发展。
texts.en: With the failure of even one participating member to eliminate their target before time ran out, the [Root.Federation.GetName]'s joint military exercises have ended in farce. We can only hope that our enemies were not watching proceedings too closely as we seek to pick up the pieces of our lost pride and restore the dignity of our fleet.

label.zh: 我们的舰队将所向披靡！

title.zh: 参与联合军事演习受限
title.en: Participation in Joint Military Exercises Curtailed

texts.zh: 我们已经离开了先前所在的联邦，因此我们无权参与其计划中的联合军事演习。
texts.en: As we have left our old federation, our participation in their planned joint military exercises has been curtailed.

texts.zh: 战争爆发导致计划中的联邦军事演习取消。
texts.en: The outbreak of war has led to the cancellation of the planned federation military exercises.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]正在举行联合军事演习，以便增强联盟内各个军队之间的凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。

演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
texts.en:
The [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName] is holding joint military exercises to improve cohesion within the diverse militaries in the alliance, as well as honing the skills of its crews.

The exercises will commence as soon as all federation fleets are in position.
